description: An attacker submits a specially crafted username parameter in a login form that does not return SQL errors or data directly. Instead, the attacker uses time-based payloads to infer valid usernames by causing delays when certain conditions are true.
payload: ' OR IF(SUBSTRING((SELECT username FROM users LIMIT 1),1,1)='a', SLEEP(5), 0)--
indicators: No direct SQL error messages or data returned in the response; Response times vary significantly depending on the input; Use of time-based SQL payloads (e.g., SLEEP function) to infer data character by character; Repeated, automated requests with incremental payload changes targeting database content

scenario: Blind SQL injection via boolean-based content inference
description: An attacker uses boolean conditional payloads in a search parameter, observing subtle differences in page content or structure (like presence/absence of certain HTML elements) to extract information from the database.
payload: ' AND (SELECT CASE WHEN (SUBSTRING((SELECT password FROM users WHERE username='admin'),1,1)='5') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1--
indicators: No explicit error messages or data leakage; Page content or response size changes based on payload conditions; Boolean conditions used in SQL payloads to infer true/false results; Multiple requests with slight payload variations targeting sensitive data extraction

scenario: Blind SQL injection through error suppression and conditional delays
description: An attacker crafts input to a vulnerable parameter that suppresses database errors and uses conditional delays to determine if certain database records exist, extracting data without visible outputs.
payload: '; IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM users WHERE email LIKE 'admin%') WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
indicators: Application does not display database error messages; Response times increase noticeably when condition is true; Use of conditional SQL statements that cause execution delays; Repeated probing to confirm existence or content of database records
